subject: done S21
body:
done S21 — authoring pipeline, question review UI, Settings + export-all

Commits on claude/naadi-shared: 17a0937, 93747b8, 61cb867, 6dea3cf (backend, export, fake gateway; migration 0024), fc4e65b/ba71ee4 (model-name prefixes), 8653a71 (web: review UI, Settings, Data & export), 3936dd9 (e2e fixes).
Tests: gate on the last integrate = lint, typecheck, vitest, 1552 pytest (-m "not live and not db") pass; db tests and drift checks pass locally against the seeded stack; e2e review.spec + settings.spec on webkit-ipad-portrait, ipad-landscape, phone-390 and chromium-laptop-1440, --retries=0: 48/48, twice in a row.
CI: https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/44038950378 (queued behind a backlog when I posted). The earlier run for fc4e65b (44024505753) was red on e2e and the db job before my e2e fixes; I did not get its cause from the log, so please read the new run before promoting.
Real-model smoke: NVIDIA author -> OpenRouter reviewer produced a grounded, lint-clean acid-base item that reached in_review.

Decisions
- Migration 0024 (question_reviews, authoring_runs backend-only RLS, export_jobs own-row, agent_health kinds). One head.
- One admin approval publishes once lint, source check and model cross-check pass; second reviewer optional. The blind solver is a different model family from every author model. Seed items go through the same queue and need the cross-check.
- All my API model names are prefixed (QuestionReviewIn, ReviewItemDetail...) to avoid OpenAPI collisions.
- Linter L06 uses containment, not Jaccard (Jaccard could never trigger on long stems). Lab-value rule tuned against the seed bank.
- Psychometrics: first attempts only, item-rest point-biserial; flags from N>=30, action only from N>=100.
- Export: server-built ZIP split into parts at 40 MB; an oversize single file is skipped and listed; owner tables = chapters, sections, media, flashcards; attempts.correct and flashcard backs are withheld for unattempted questions; vault files only if the box is ticked; notes PDFs come from the browser exporter.
- AUTHORING_FAKE=1 swaps in a scripted gateway (ignored in prod).

Open items for others
- GET /api/nav builds nav with is_admin=False, so the admin "Review" entry never shows (S03 design). S19's hub should link /admin/review; I did not change nav.
- question_review is not yet registered in S19's queue registry, and review_store.snapshot_revision does not yet call S19's snapshot_question; I'll wire both when their modules are on shared and say so here.
- e2e gotchas: once the service worker controls a page, Playwright stubs miss its requests and page.reload() skips them (use serviceWorkers:"block" or in-app navigation); Playwright globalSetup wipes .auth so concurrent runs collide; the fake author template trips L16 after the first fake item is embedded (e2e_fake_items.py cleans up); scripts/seed.py verification fails once admins mark seeds reviewed.
- docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md: I did not walk it item by item in this final pass; the colour roles, no-answer-before-attempt and secrets rules were kept throughout.
